headline: Mid-range after a blow-off top; holding the 50 EMA

meta.market_state_note: Parabolic blow-off → 41% crash to the 50 EMA → 4H bounce. Genuinely neutral at $2.15 (mid-range). No trade here — long the $1.90-1.95 dip, or short the $2.40-2.80 distribution supply; a break of $1.81 or $2.55 resolves it.

factors.evidence: Parabolic rally $1.26 → $3.09 (+145% in ~5 weeks), then a violent ~41% reversal to $1.81 that broke the last higher low (BOS down) — but the drop bottomed on the rising 50 EMA and is bouncing. A damaged uptrend at a decision point.
Price ~at the 20 EMA, above the 50 EMA; 20 > 50 — bullish stack (computed from closes).
Price below AVWAP (anchored well above, off the higher cycle).
Reset from overbought to the midline; RSI below its (elevated) MA — momentum cooled off the blow-off.
Rally ran 167-187M up-days; the reversal/dump ran 127-150M (~10x the ~37M avg) — heavy distribution off the top.
Higher highs/higher lows off the $1.8143 low (1.81 → 1.88 → 1.96 → 2.09 lows; 1.95 → 2.10 → 2.23 highs). A short-term uptrend off the low.
Price $2.15 is above the 4H 20 EMA — reclaimed on the bounce.
Far below; stale far-back anchor (see Analyst Notes).
RSI back above the midline and above its MA (42) — short-term momentum up.
Dump bars ran ~33M; bounce bars 12-20M — recovering but below the distribution.

setup.thesis: No clean directional edge at $2.15 (mid-range). Trade the boundaries: a dip toward $1.90-1.95 (4H higher-low / range support) is the long-the-bounce entry toward $2.4-2.5; a rally into $2.4-2.8 (distribution supply) is the short-the-blow-off entry back toward $1.81. A decisive loss of $1.81 (bear) or reclaim of $2.5+ (bull) resolves the range and overrides the neutral stance.
setup.not: Not Trend Continuation (no clean trend); not Breakout/Breakdown (acceptance unconfirmed).

verdict.rationale: Genuinely neutral and no clean trade at $2.15 — price is mid-range, the worst location. Trade the boundaries: long a dip to $1.90-1.95 (stop <$1.81) toward $2.40-2.55, or short a rally into the $2.40-2.80 distribution supply back toward $1.81. A 4H close below $1.81 flips it bearish; acceptance above ~$2.55 flips it bullish. Don't trade the middle.

evidence_matrix.reading: Blow-off top $3.09 → 41% crash, BOS down, but held the 50 EMA
Climactic distribution off the top (127-150M, ~10x avg)
4H RSI ~52 > MA; daily ~51 < MA — split, midline
OI flushed 43M→33M (exhaustion); funding flat; CVD bearish divergence on the bounce

analyst_summary: NEAR is the genuine neutral of the set — a parabolic leader (+145% to $3.09) that blew off, crashed 41% to its rising 50 EMA ($1.82), held it, and is bouncing. The daily EMA stack is bullish and the 4H has recovered (HH/HL, reclaimed 4H 20 EMA), but distribution volume, a structure break, and price below AVWAP keep it from being a bullish call.
Bias is Neutral/transitional (4/3/3) — a coin-flip at a decision point. No directional edge at $2.15 (mid-range).

Trade the boundaries: a dip to $1.90-1.95 is the long-the-bounce entry toward $2.40-2.50; a rally into $2.40-2.80 distribution is the short-the-blow-off entry back toward $1.81. A loss of $1.81 (bear) or reclaim of $2.55 (bull) resolves the range.

Caveats: blow-off tops deserve respect (if $1.81 breaks, downside can be fast); AVWAP (~$3.43) is a stale anchor; OI/Funding/CVD unavailable (notable on a parabolic move); high-beta to BTC — the boundary that breaks will likely follow BTC.
bottom_line: Neutral / no clean trade at $2.15. Range rotation — long the $1.90-1.95 dip or short the $2.40-2.80 supply; a break of $1.81 or $2.55 resolves it. Don't trade the middle.

bullish_upgrade.title: Bullish Resolution
bullish_upgrade.subtitle: Uptrend Resumes
bullish_upgrade.result: Uptrend resumes; bias flips bullish toward $2.8-3.09.

bull_case: Parabolic leader pulled back to the rising 50 EMA ($1.82) and held, bullish EMA stack, confirmed 4H recovery — a buy-the-dip toward $2.4-2.8.
bear_case: Parabolic blow-off top with a 41% crash on ~10x distribution volume and a structure break — the bounce is a relief rally into supply that fails toward $1.5-1.6.

trade_plan.direction: Range Rotation — Long the Dip / Short the Rally

support.label: Range Support / Long Entry (4H PR Lower-1 ~$1.91)

failure_scenario: A decisive directional break — most concerning, a loss of $1.81 that confirms the blow-off top and trends toward the catching-up 50 EMA / $1.5-1.6; or a reclaim of $2.5+ that resumes the uptrend and squeezes shorts.
derivatives_summary: Selling pressure is being flushed out, but buyers are not yet in control.
conclusion: Neutral / No Clean Trade — Range Rotation; actionable only at the $1.81/$2.8 boundaries, not mid-range.
